title: The operator's decision a call carries in _meta.decision (fabric-actions/0.1, DEC-0121 AP-2)
description: The operator's decision on one relayed action, carried by a T0 or T1 caller in its request's _meta.decision (or the sealed call's decision over the relay). by is always operator and via is always relayed-instruction: an agent sets it only for an instruction the operator gave in its own session, quoting the operator's sentence that names the action (AP-3). A decision through an elicitation is the service's own record, never the caller's claim. action is the declared action's id and must be the called one. A service reads at strictly (src/rfc3339.ts strictTime) and refuses decision-invalid a decision more than 60 s after its clock or more than 24 h before it. docs/specification/service.md#actions.

action.description: The id of the declared action this decision is for (extensions/actions/0.1).

instruction.description: The operator's sentence that names this action, verbatim.
